# AgentOps Stacks

> A Databricks Asset Bundle (DAB) template for production AI agent projects. Run `databricks bundle init agentops-stacks` to generate a fully-wired project with data preparation, LangGraph agent development, MLflow 3 evaluation, Mosaic AI model serving, and a Dash chat UI — with CI/CD for GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab.

This is a **template repository**, not a deployable project. Initialize it with the Databricks CLI to generate a project. Every file ending in `.tmpl` is a Go template source; the generated output drops the `.tmpl` suffix.

## Initialization

- [Template schema](databricks_template_schema.json): All parameters, types, defaults, and allowed values — read this first to understand what gets generated
- [Databricks bundle init docs](https://docs.databricks.com/dev-tools/cli/bundle-cli.html): How `databricks bundle init` consumes this template
- [Hooks](hooks/): Pre/post-generation scripts run by the Databricks CLI
- [Library](library/): Go template helper functions shared across `.tmpl` files

## Generated Project Files

- [Bundle config template](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/databricks.yml.tmpl): Root DAB config — targets (dev/staging/prod/test), all variables, resource includes
- [Requirements](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/requirements.txt.tmpl): Data preparation Python dependencies
- [Agent requirements](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/agent_development/agent_requirements.txt.tmpl): Agent-specific dependencies, separate from data prep

## Pipeline Notebooks (in execution order)

- [DataIngestion](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/data_preparation/DataIngestion.py.tmpl): Scrapes XML sitemap → raw Delta table
- [DataPreprocessing](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/data_preparation/DataPreprocessing.py.tmpl): Chunks documents → preprocessed Delta table
- [VectorSearch](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/data_preparation/VectorSearch.py.tmpl): Creates/syncs Databricks Vector Search index
- [Agent](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/agent_development/Agent.py.tmpl): Creates UC functions, logs LangGraph agent with MLflow, registers model
- [AgentEvaluation](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/agent_development/AgentEvaluation.py.tmpl): Runs mlflow.genai.evaluate() with LLM-as-a-judge scorers
- [ModelServing](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/agent_deployment/ModelServing.py.tmpl): Calls agents.deploy() to create Mosaic AI serving endpoint

## DAB Resource Definitions

- [Data preparation job](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/resources/data-preparation-resource.yml.tmpl): `data_preprocessing_job` with tasks RawDataIngest → PreprocessRawData → VectorSearchIndex
- [Agent development job](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/resources/agent-resource.yml.tmpl): `agent_development_job` with tasks AgentDevelopment → AgentEvaluation → AgentDeployment
- [Artifacts](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/resources/agents-artifacts-resource.yml.tmpl): Registered model and MLflow experiment definitions
- [App resource](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/resources/app-resource.yml.tmpl): Databricks App definition pointing to chat_interface_deployment/

## Chat Interface

- [App source](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/agent_deployment/chat_interface_deployment/app.py.tmpl): Dash chat UI — reads SERVING_ENDPOINT from environment variable
- [App config](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/agent_deployment/chat_interface_deployment/app.yaml.tmpl): Databricks App command config (`python app.py`)

## CI/CD Templates

- [GitHub Actions workflows](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/.github/workflows/): bundle-ci, run-tests, cd-staging, cd-prod, deploy-cicd, lint
- [Azure DevOps pipelines](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/.azure/devops-pipelines/): tests-ci, bundle-cicd, deploy-cicd
- [GitLab pipelines](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/.gitlab/pipelines/): bundle-ci, cd-staging, cd-prod, triggers-cicd

## Documentation

- [Project README template](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/README.md.tmpl): Per-project deployment walkthrough and customization table
- [AgentOps setup guide](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/docs/agentops-setup.md.tmpl): Full CI/CD setup — service principals, secrets, branch policies
- [Resource configuration guide](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/resources/README_agentops.md.tmpl): DAB concepts, environment targets, local dev workflow
- [AI context for generated projects](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/llms.txt.tmpl): Machine-readable deployment guide generated into every project
- [Coding agent instructions](template/{{.input_root_dir}}/AGENTS.md.tmpl): AGENTS.md standard — project conventions for AI coding agents

## Testing

- [Template tests](tests/): 27 parameterized combinations (3 clouds × 3 CI/CD platforms × 3 setup modes)
- [Dev requirements](dev-requirements.txt): Install before running tests
- [Conftest](conftest.py): Pytest fixtures for template generation and project structure validation

## Optional

- [Stack customization guide](stack-customization.md): How to fork and extend this template for your own use cases
- [Pipeline overview](Pipeline.md): End-to-end pipeline architecture
